title: The map says how the code fits together, in checked prose, in every repo
why: Your ask, Oct 27 15:28 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2TkTAVedLJHUNKVx7WVmM42): a map that you and the AI both read before answering "how does X work", which stops building a second copy where a shared thing exists, records facts like a retry wait or which avenues a pricing export covers, and checks that what we say in English is what the code does. You asked to be told plainly if this is the wrong avenue.
note:
Before the pilot, the map check proved only that an entry exists, not that its prose is true. Prose that nothing checks rots.

Plan done Oct 28: plans/c146-checked-prose-map.md (Sonnet fact-check clear). MAP9 in skills/plain-english-map/scripts/map-check.mjs checks indented fact lines that cite a symbol's value, uses FILE:SYMBOL relations and a Homes section; a CI step.
